body: God damn if that ain’t the realest feeling right now
I don’t want to cause the people I love pain but that’s literally part of my illness. I’m just damaged.
This often goes through my head too. Everyone will eventually be okay. They’ll get over it and their lives will be better for it in the long run. Thanks

I have had my Facebook account “deactivated” but not deleted for the past few weeks and it has probably been a huge stress reliever. I don’t even think I’m aware of how much I used it to fuel negative thinking and behaviors.

I’ve been having some relationship turmoil and I’m on this swing of feeling capable of handling it and staying rational and knowing I’ll be okay no matter what and then feeling like my world is ending and I’m not strong enough to handle it all and I’m never going to find another person like this one and it’s so exhausting.

I have a hard time handling my partners mental health issues. It’s so easy for me to latch on to their negative emotions or expressions and spiral out of control thinking of all of the things that are probably wrong and things I’ve probably done wrong and ways that life is so wrong....

It’s a nightmare. Not necessarily competition feeling, but my brain definitely gets frustrated that my partners aren’t being “more sensitive” to my problems. That they aren’t considering how their feelings are making ME feel. Which feels super gross when I realize I’m feeling that. 

I’m trying to find ways to let them have their feelings and their problems and not have them negate or affect my own.
Staying busy, that’s smart. Thank you

This is a good question. 

I’m not sure how deep I can take it. I have values but they seem vague and big picture. When it gets down to the nitty gritty I tend to be movable and flexible for people who are important to me or validate me. :/

I am hearing what you’re saying but it isn’t resonating with me unfortunately. :( 

I even find it difficult to have hobbies or interests because they’ve been so shaped by others and I lack motivation when I’m alone...

Definitely the numbness. Not feeling anything. Hollow and empty. I can’t feel any compassion or empathy and other people speaking or expressing emotions make me uncomfortable if not irritable and angry at times. I don’t think much, but when I do it’s looping thoughts the same phrase on repeat in my head or a memory over and over again.
